capabilities: Render GitHub Gists from fenced code blocks
Embed a Gist by its ID
Embed a Gist by username and ID
Show a single file from a Gist
extras: README covers only usage examples and installation; no explanation of options beyond the three code block forms.
problem: Obsidian cannot render GitHub Gists embedded in notes; the Gist code block just shows as plain text.
summary: GitHub Gist embedder that renders Gist fenced code blocks as embedded Gist views in notes.
